Calculate the electrical resistivity of a wire given the following parameters.
The wire has a length L of 0.492 m.
The wire has a diameter d of 1.944 mm, which must be converted to meters (0.001944 m) before use in calculations.
The wire has an electrical resistance R of 11.705 Ω.
Compute the cross-sectional area using the correct circular geometry formula A = πd²/4, with d in meters.
Compute the electrical resistivity using ρ = R·A/L.
Report the final resistivity value in units of Ω·m.
